title: Pandolfi's teenage metallurgical analysis of a Glomar Explorer piece

tellings.quote: >> Well, that's that's another story. The story was that his father gave him a piece that he was they were involved with the uh uh Glowar Explorer.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron told podcast host Jesse Michels a story about Ron Pandolfi, a man Cameron describes as a senior figure in the government's handling of UFOs. According to Cameron, when Pandolfi was a teenager his father, who was involved with a secret ship called the Glomar Explorer, gave him a piece of metal from that work to analyse. Cameron tells it as an early sign of Pandolfi's ties to hidden government projects.
